An '''''YV-865 Aurore''-class freighter''' was owned by [[Preigo/Legends|Preigo]] and his [[Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder/Legends|group of performers]] around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. The group was traveling on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] to perform for [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|his gang]], when they met [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiates]], who pretended to be professional performers. The younglings messed up the show, and the group of performers had to escape.
